shared_schema.envelope: All stage payloads use schema_version and synthetic=true, validated by validate(stage, payload).
shared_schema.input: allowed_hosts, urls, fixture_pages keyed by exact URL, optional document_rules.field_mapping
shared_schema.source: source_id, url, title, media_type, body, sha256
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, research, documents, sentiment
shared_schema.error: One JSON object with status=error and error message; exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Research validates allowlisted HTTPS URLs and retrieves exact fixture pages, preserving body, title, URL and SHA-256.

Documents validates research hashes and allowlist before parsing JSON arrays or CSV, mapping source fields into canonical records, trimming strings and checking required fields, severity and globally unique IDs.
Sentiment validates document records and their research provenance before scoring; original records and provenance persist in each issue. Final validation recomputes scores and verifies ordering.

behavior.retrieval: Offline fixture-backed retrieval only; fixtures are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.document_automation: General configurable field extraction and reshaping from JSON/CSV customer document exports, not tied to a particular vendor.
behavior.sentiment: Deterministic English lexicon; preceding three word negation with sentence punctuation reset; signed evidence, raw score and normalized score. Unmatched text is neutral.
behavior.priority: Severity dominates: critical=P0, high=P1, medium=P2, low=P3; ties use ascending raw sentiment score then issue_id.
behavior.severity: Conservative phrase escalation: security breach, data loss and injury to critical; outage to high. Mentions escalate even when negated; flags are review hints, not factual incident determinations.
behavior.limits: 50 URLs, 1,000,000 characters per source, 2,000,000 input characters, 10,000 canonical records.
behavior.duplicates: Duplicate URLs, JSON keys, CSV headers and issue IDs are rejected rather than silently merged.
behavior.empty_documents: Empty JSON arrays and header-only CSV are accepted with zero issues.

test_outcomes.cli: Example command exited 0 and printed one JSON object with status=ok and three prioritized issues; file, usage and invalid-input errors verified with status=error and exit 2.
